title: Among molecules containing double bonds, identify the top 3 most common ele
question: Among molecules containing double bonds, identify the top 3 most common elements found in carcinogenic molecules. For each element, calculate what percentage of molecules with that element are carcinogenic versus non-carcinogenic.

prediction.sql:
WITH double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
),
element_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS total_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN a.XCL_002 END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN double_bond_molecules AS dbm ON a.XCL_002 = dbm.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
)
SELECT 
    element,
    CAST(carcinogenic_molecules AS REAL) * 100 / total_molecules AS pct_carcinogenic,
    CAST((total_molecules - carcinogenic_molecules) AS REAL) * 100 / total_molecules AS pct_non_carcinogenic
FROM element_stats
ORDER BY carcinogenic_molecules DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
),
element_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.XCL_003 AS element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_002) AS total_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN a.XCL_002 END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN double_bond_molecules AS dbm ON a.XCL_002 = dbm.molecule_id
    INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
)
SELECT 
    element,
    CAST(carcinogenic_molecules AS REAL) * 100 / total_molecules AS pct_carcinogenic,
    CAST((total_molecules - carcinogenic_molecules) AS REAL) * 100 / total_molecules AS pct_non_carcinogenic
FROM element_stats
ORDER BY carcinogenic_molecules DESC
LIMIT 3

       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN m.XCL_010 END) AS carcinogenic_molecules,

    LEFT JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.XCL_002 = cm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
)
SELECT 
    es.element,
    es.carcinogenic_molecules * 100.0 / es.total_molecules AS carcinogenic_percentage,
    (es.total_molecules - es.carcinogenic_molecules) * 100.0 / es.total_molecules AS non_carcinogenic_percentage
FROM element_stats es
ORDER BY es.carcinogenic_molecules DESC
LIMIT 3
